_help.about: Where camp fires — the safe zones you can wake at after dying — are found (design 29 Sept 2026: only in the rare ruins). Restart after editing.
_help.only_at_ruins: true: camps exist only at inhabited ruins (about half of them) and at the opening encampment; the wild riverside camps and the cliff rock shelters are not placed, and wanderers never make a fire for you. false: the older rule (nearest camp of any kind).
_help.wake_random: true: after a death you wake at a RANDOM inhabited ruin's fire within wake_radius_m of where you died, a different one each time; false: the nearest.
_help.wake_radius_m: How far from where you died the fire can be. If no inhabited ruin lies within it the search widens (x2, up to widen_steps times); failing that you wake at the opening camp.
